import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- 1. Does S. cerevisiae encode SCOT (EC 2.8.3.5)? comparative control ----------
def prot_count(proteome, ec):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":f"(proteome:{proteome}) AND (ec:{ec})","size":20,
                "fields":"accession,protein_name,gene_names,ec","format":"tsv"},timeout=90)
    lines=[l for l in r.text.split("\n") if l.strip()]
    return lines
PROTEOMES={"A. fumigatus Af293":"UP000002530","S. cerevisiae S288C":"UP000002311",
           "A. nidulans FGSC A4":"UP000000560","H. sapiens":"UP000005640"}
print("=== Comparative presence of ketone-body enzymes (UniProt EC query per reference proteome) ===")
tab=[]
for ec,label in [("2.8.3.5","SCOT / 3-oxoacid CoA-transferase"),("1.1.1.30","3-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase"),
                 ("4.1.3.4","HMG-CoA lyase"),("2.3.3.10","HMG-CoA synthase"),("2.3.1.9","acetoacetyl-CoA thiolase")]:
    row={"EC":ec,"enzyme":label}
    for org,p in PROTEOMES.items():
        row[org]=len(prot_count(p,ec))-1
    tab.append(row)
cmp=pd.DataFrame(tab); print(cmp.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 2. sequences ----------
ACC={"Af_Erg10A":"Q4WLA8","Af_Erg10B":"Q4WCL5","Af_AFUA_4G10950":"Q4WPY9","Af_AFUA_7G04080":"Q4WG79",
 "Af_Kat1_2G11350":"Q4X135","Af_AFUA_1G12650":"E9RBL5",
 "Af_CoAtr_6G12250":"Q4WLU8","Af_CoAtr_3G04030":"Q4WEZ2","Af_CoAtr_1G04120":"Q4WK09",
 "Af_Erg13A":"Q4WBQ3","Af_Erg13B":"Q4WXT8","Af_HMGCL_7G01720":"Q4WAL4","Af_HMGCL_2G12450":"Q4X0S6",
 "Af_BDHcand_5G09290":"Q4WUQ4","Af_IvdA_5G08930":"Q4WUM0","Af_MccA_5G08910":"Q4WUL8","Af_MccB_5G08940":"Q4WUM1",
 # positive controls: experimentally mitochondrial-matrix, cleavable presequence
 "POS_Hs_ACAT1":"P24752","POS_Hs_OXCT1":"P55809","POS_Hs_HMGCS2":"P54868","POS_Hs_HMGCL":"P35914",
 "POS_Hs_BDH1":"Q02338","POS_Sc_CIT1_mito":"P00890","POS_Sc_ACO1_mito":"P19414",
 # negative controls: cytosolic
 "NEG_Hs_ACAT2":"Q9BWD1","NEG_Sc_ERG10":"P41338","NEG_Hs_HMGCS1":"Q01581",
 "NEG_Sc_CIT2_perox":"P08679","NEG_Sc_PGK1_cyto":"P00560",
 # specificity control for CoA-transferase family confusion (Fleck & Brock PMID 18331473 enzyme family)
 "CTRL_Sc_ACH1_hydrolase":"P32316"}
seq={}
for n,a in ACC.items():
    seq[n]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")

# ---------- 3. N-terminal presequence score (calibrated on the controls) ----------
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def mts(s,w=40):
    n=s[:w]
    R=n.count('R'); K=n.count('K'); DE=n.count('D')+n.count('E')
    net=(R+K)-DE
    # max hydrophobic moment of an amphipathic alpha-helix (100 deg/res) over 18-residue windows
    best=0.0
    for i in range(0,max(1,len(n)-17)):
        win=n[i:i+18]
        ang=np.deg2rad(100*np.arange(len(win)))
        h=np.array([KD.get(c,0) for c in win])
        best=max(best, np.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(win))
    return dict(Arg=R, Lys=K, DE=DE, netcharge=net, muH=round(best,2), noD_E_in20=(0==(n[:20].count('D')+n[:20].count('E'))))
rows=[]
for n in ACC:
    d=mts(seq[n]); d["protein"]=n; d["len"]=len(seq[n]); rows.append(d)
M=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("protein")[["len","Arg","Lys","DE","netcharge","muH","noD_E_in20"]]
M["class"]=["pos-ctrl" if n.startswith("POS_") else "neg-ctrl" if n.startswith("NEG_") else "spec-ctrl" if n.startswith("CTRL_") else "Af-query" for n in M.index]
print("\n=== N-terminal 40-residue presequence features (calibrated with controls) ===")
print(M.to_string())
print("\nControl separation on net charge (N-term 40 aa):")
print("  mitochondrial positive controls:", M[M['class']=='pos-ctrl']['netcharge'].tolist(), "median", M[M['class']=='pos-ctrl']['netcharge'].median())
print("  cytosolic negative controls:    ", M[M['class']=='neg-ctrl']['netcharge'].tolist(), "median", M[M['class']=='neg-ctrl']['netcharge'].median())
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,p=mannwhitneyu(M[M['class']=='pos-ctrl']['netcharge'],M[M['class']=='neg-ctrl']['netcharge'],alternative='greater')
print(f"  Mann-Whitney U={u}, one-sided p={p:.4f}  (n=7 vs n=5)")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5))
col={'pos-ctrl':'#2c7fb8','neg-ctrl':'#d95f02','spec-ctrl':'#777777','Af-query':'#1b9e77'}
for c in col:
    sub=M[M['class']==c]
    ax.scatter(sub['netcharge'],sub['muH'],s=90,label=c,color=col[c],edgecolor='k',linewidth=0.5)
    for n,r in sub.iterrows(): ax.annotate(n.replace('POS_','').replace('NEG_','').replace('CTRL_',''),(r['netcharge'],r['muH']),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvline(2.5,ls='--',c='grey'); ax.set_xlabel("net charge of N-terminal 40 residues"); ax.set_ylabel("max amphipathic helix hydrophobic moment (18-aa window)")
ax.set_title("N-terminal presequence features, A. fumigatus candidates against mitochondrial and cytosolic controls")
ax.legend(); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
